name: Cover cropping between cash crops

soft_risks.risk: Cover crop water use competes with the cash crop and can reduce its yield in dry conditions
soft_risks.mitigation: Terminate early, choose low-water-use species, or pair with no-till and residue mulching so the water is returned as cover

soft_risks.risk: Insufficient rainfall to establish the cover without drawing down stored soil water
soft_risks.mitigation: Restrict to seasons with reliable rainfall, or grow only where supplemental water exists

mechanism: A living cover returns root and shoot biomass to the soil between cash crops, feeding soil biota and protecting the surface from erosion.

region_variants.note: FAO reports that in semiarid regions cover crops may reduce cash crop yields under conventional tillage but not under no-tillage, because evapotranspiration is lower.
